# THE SNOW GLOBE: a 3 m glass globe on a carved wooden pedestal, on a table in a candle-lit room at night. Inside, a snowy hill with a little village of lit houses around a chapel with a spire, pines, a frozen pond
# with a skater circling it, and a toy train on a ring of track; snow drifts down through it. Every 14 s the whole globe is lifted, shaken and set down and a burst of snow whirls up and settles again.
# Everything is generated by our own language. Metres, +y up: the table top is y = 0, the globe's centre (0, 2.55, 0), its radius 1.5; the village floor is y = 1.45.
# Hierarchy: snowglobe (the pedestal: lifts and shakes) > the glass, the hill and everything on it, the snow, all following it. Open the world with scene=open.
# kind: world
# a dim, cool night: the room is lit by a candle, a lamp, and the glow of the globe's own windows
sky = scene.sky@1(sun_elevation=2, sun_azimuth=-40, sun_intensity=0.35, turbidity=3, ground_color=[0.08, 0.06, 0.05], clouds=false, haze=0.0)
env = scene.environment@1(sky_color=[0.42, 0.5, 0.72], ground_color=[0.2, 0.14, 0.1], intensity=0.55, reflection=0.5, bounce=0.5)
output sky = sky
output env = env

# ================================================= THE ROOM =================================================
table_b = solid.box@1(size=[9, 0.3, 6])
table_a = xform.move@1(table_b, by=[0, -0.15, 0])
table_m = solid.material@1(table_a, color=[0.36, 0.22, 0.12], roughness=0.6, recipe="planks")
output table = table_m
wall_b = solid.box@1(size=[9, 5, 0.3])
wall_a = xform.move@1(wall_b, by=[0, 2.5, -3.1])
wall_m = solid.material@1(wall_a, color=[0.2, 0.15, 0.2], roughness=0.85, recipe="wood")
output back_wall = wall_m
# a candle and its flame, a stack of books, and a brass winding key
candle_c = solid.cylinder@1(radius=0.07, height=0.34, segments=16)
candle_a = xform.move@1(candle_c, by=[2.3, 0.17, 0.9])
candle_m = solid.material@1(candle_a, color=[0.95, 0.9, 0.78], roughness=0.7)
output candle = candle_m
flame_s = solid.sphere@1(radius=0.03, segments=8)
flame_a = xform.move@1(flame_s, by=[2.3, 0.4, 0.9])
flame_e = fx.emitter@1(flame_a, name="candle", rate=40, lifetime=[0.3, 0.6], speed=[0.2, 0.5], direction=[0, 1, 0], cone=10, shape="disc", extent=[0.02, 0, 0], size=[0.07, 0.01], colour=[1.0, 0.75, 0.3], colour_end=[0.9, 0.3, 0.05], alpha=[1, 0], glow=3, blend="additive", max_particles=150)
flame_f = fx.force@1(flame_e, kind="turbulence", strength=1.2, scale=1.5)
flame_m = solid.material@1(flame_f, color=[1.0, 0.8, 0.4], roughness=0.5, emissive=[4, 2.5, 0.8])
output candle_flame = flame_m
candle_light = light.point@1(position=[2.3, 0.7, 0.9], color=[1.0, 0.7, 0.35], intensity=45, range=10)
lamp_light = light.point@1(position=[-3.2, 3.6, 1.8], color=[1.0, 0.85, 0.65], intensity=60, range=12)
book1_b = solid.box@1(size=[0.9, 0.16, 0.65])
book1_a = xform.move@1(book1_b, by=[-2.6, 0.08, 0.7])
book1_m = solid.material@1(book1_a, color=[0.45, 0.1, 0.1], roughness=0.7)
output book_a = book1_m
book2_b = solid.box@1(size=[0.8, 0.14, 0.6])
book2_r = xform.rotate@1(book2_b, angles=[0, 12, 0])
book2_a = xform.move@1(book2_r, by=[-2.58, 0.23, 0.72])
book2_m = solid.material@1(book2_a, color=[0.12, 0.28, 0.4], roughness=0.7)
output book_b = book2_m

# ================================================= THE BUILDER =================================================
# jg: helpers and the little world inside. gy(x, z) is the height of the hill (a snow dome on the village floor, y = 1.45); every house, tree and track stands at that height.
let jg = "const TAU = Math.PI * 2, YF = 1.45; const hash = (n) => { const s = Math.sin(n * 12.9898 + 4.1414) * 43758.5453; return s - Math.floor(s); }; const sstep = (a, b, x) => { const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }; const gy = (x, z) => YF + 0.6 * Math.pow(1 - sstep(0, 0.95, Math.hypot(x, z)), 1.5); const two = (m) => (...ids) => { m.face(...ids); m.face(...ids.slice().reverse()); }; const boxY = (m, cx, cy, cz, sx, sy, sz, yaw) => { const f = two(m), c = Math.cos(yaw), s = Math.sin(yaw), v = []; for (const dy of [-0.5, 0.5]) for (const q of [[-0.5, -0.5], [0.5, -0.5], [0.5, 0.5], [-0.5, 0.5]]) { const lx = q[0] * sx, lz = q[1] * sz; v.push(m.vertex(cx + lx * c + lz * s, cy + dy * sy, cz - lx * s + lz * c)); } f(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3]); f(v[4], v[5], v[6], v[7]); f(v[0], v[1], v[5], v[4]); f(v[1], v[2], v[6], v[5]); f(v[2], v[3], v[7], v[6]); f(v[3], v[0], v[4], v[7]); }; const cyl = (m, x, z, y0, y1, r0, r1, n) => { const f = two(m), a = [], b = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const t = TAU * i / n; a.push(m.vertex(x + r0 * Math.cos(t), y0, z + r0 * Math.sin(t))); b.push(m.vertex(x + r1 * Math.cos(t), y1, z + r1 * Math.sin(t))); } const apex = r1 < 0.0005 ? m.vertex(x, y1, z) : null; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = (i + 1) % n; if (apex !== null) f(a[i], a[j], apex); else f(a[i], a[j], b[j], b[i]); } f(...a); if (apex === null) f(...b); }; const gable = (m, cx, cy, cz, len, wid, rh, yaw) => { const f = two(m), c = Math.cos(yaw), s = Math.sin(yaw), L = len / 2 + 0.02, Wd = wid / 2 + 0.02; const v = (lx, y, lz) => m.vertex(cx + lx * c + lz * s, y, cz - lx * s + lz * c); const a0 = v(-L, cy, -Wd), a1 = v(L, cy, -Wd), b0 = v(-L, cy, Wd), b1 = v(L, cy, Wd), r0 = v(-L, cy + rh, 0), r1 = v(L, cy + rh, 0); f(a0, a1, r1, r0); f(b0, r0, r1, b1); f(a0, r0, b0); f(a1, b1, r1); }; const HS = [[0.32, 0.18, 0.2, 0.16, 0.14], [-0.3, 0.22, 0.18, 0.15, 0.13], [0.38, -0.22, 0.2, 0.16, 0.15], [-0.36, -0.2, 0.19, 0.16, 0.13], [0.05, 0.42, 0.17, 0.14, 0.12], [0.08, -0.45, 0.2, 0.16, 0.14], [-0.58, 0.0, 0.18, 0.15, 0.12], [0.62, 0.0, 0.17, 0.14, 0.12]]; const yawOf = (x, z, k) => Math.atan2(-x, -z) + (hash(k + 3) - 0.5) * 0.4; function hill() { const m = new Mesh(); const f = two(m); const NR = 26, NS = 56, R = 1.0; const ids = []; for (let i = 0; i <= NR; i++) { const r = R * i / NR, row = []; for (let j = 0; j < NS; j++) { const a = j / NS * TAU; row.push(m.vertex(r * Math.cos(a), gy(r * Math.cos(a), r * Math.sin(a)), r * Math.sin(a))); } ids.push(row); } for (let i = 0; i < NR; i++) for (let j = 0; j < NS; j++) { const j2 = (j + 1) % NS; if (i === 0) f(ids[0][0], ids[1][j], ids[1][j2]); else f(ids[i][j], ids[i + 1][j], ids[i + 1][j2], ids[i][j2]); } cyl(m, 0, 0, 1.3, YF, R, R, 24); return m; } function walls() { const m = new Mesh(); HS.forEach((h, k) => { boxY(m, h[0], gy(h[0], h[1]) + h[4] / 2, h[1], h[2], h[4], h[3], yawOf(h[0], h[1], k)); }); return m; } function roofs() { const m = new Mesh(); HS.forEach((h, k) => { gable(m, h[0], gy(h[0], h[1]) + h[4], h[1], h[2], h[3], 0.09, yawOf(h[0], h[1], k) + Math.PI / 2); }); gable(m, 0, YF + 0.6 + 0.2, 0, 0.36, 0.22, 0.1, Math.PI / 2); return m; } function chapel() { const m = new Mesh(); const y = YF + 0.6; boxY(m, 0, y + 0.1, 0, 0.22, 0.2, 0.36, 0); boxY(m, 0, y + 0.17, 0.2, 0.13, 0.34, 0.13, 0); return m; } function spire() { const m = new Mesh(); cyl(m, 0, 0.2, YF + 0.6 + 0.34, YF + 0.6 + 0.62, 0.1, 0, 8); return m; } function windows(lit) { const m = new Mesh(); HS.forEach((h, k) => { const y = gy(h[0], h[1]), yaw = yawOf(h[0], h[1], k), c = Math.cos(yaw), s = Math.sin(yaw); for (const sg of [-1, 1]) { const lx = sg * h[2] * 0.22, lz = h[3] / 2 + 0.003, on = hash(k * 7 + sg + 11) > 0.25; if (on === lit) boxY(m, h[0] + lx * c + lz * s, y + h[4] * 0.55, h[1] - lx * s + lz * c, 0.04, 0.05, 0.012, yaw); } }); if (lit) { boxY(m, 0, YF + 0.7, 0.384, 0.05, 0.1, 0.012, 0); boxY(m, 0, YF + 0.6 + 0.24, 0.27, 0.04, 0.07, 0.012, 0); } return m; } function pines() { const m = new Mesh(); const f = two(m); const cone = (cx, cz, y0, y1, r, n) => { const a = [], t = m.vertex(cx, y1, cz); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const q = TAU * i / n; a.push(m.vertex(cx + r * Math.cos(q), y0, cz + r * Math.sin(q))); } for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) f(a[i], a[(i + 1) % n], t); }; let placed = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 200 && placed < 36; i++) { const a = hash(i) * TAU, r = 0.22 + 0.72 * Math.sqrt(hash(i + 50)), x = r * Math.cos(a), z = r * Math.sin(a); if (r > 0.93 || Math.abs(r - 0.82) < 0.05 || Math.hypot(x + 0.5, z + 0.45) < 0.34) continue; if (HS.some((h) => Math.hypot(x - h[0], z - h[1]) < 0.17)) continue; if (Math.hypot(x, z) < 0.3) continue; placed++; const s = 0.8 + 0.5 * hash(i + 90), y = gy(x, z) - 0.01; cyl(m, x, z, y, y + 0.04 * s, 0.012, 0.01, 5); cone(x, z, y + 0.025 * s, y + 0.15 * s, 0.07 * s, 7); cone(x, z, y + 0.075 * s, y + 0.22 * s, 0.055 * s, 7); cone(x, z, y + 0.13 * s, y + 0.29 * s, 0.04 * s, 7); } return m; } function pond() { const m = new Mesh(); const f = two(m); const cx = -0.5, cz = -0.45, y = gy(cx, cz) + 0.012, c = m.vertex(cx, y, cz); const ring = []; for (let j = 0; j < 40; j++) { const a = j / 40 * TAU; ring.push(m.vertex(cx + 0.29 * Math.cos(a), y, cz + 0.22 * Math.sin(a))); } for (let j = 0; j < 40; j++) f(c, ring[j], ring[(j + 1) % 40]); return m; } function skater() { const m = new Mesh(); const cx = -0.5, cz = -0.45, y = gy(cx, cz) + 0.012, x = cx + 0.15, z = cz; cyl(m, x, z, y, y + 0.07, 0.014, 0.01, 8); cyl(m, x, z, y + 0.07, y + 0.095, 0.011, 0.011, 8); cyl(m, x, z, y + 0.095, y + 0.13, 0.012, 0.0, 8); return m; } function track() { const m = new Mesh(); const R = 0.82, pts = []; const f = two(m); for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) { const a = i / 90 * TAU, a2 = (i + 1) / 90 * TAU, y = gy(R * Math.cos(a), R * Math.sin(a)) + 0.008, y2 = gy(R * Math.cos(a2), R * Math.sin(a2)) + 0.008; for (const dr of [-0.022, 0.022]) { const p0 = [(R + dr) * Math.cos(a), y, (R + dr) * Math.sin(a)], p1 = [(R + dr) * Math.cos(a2), y2, (R + dr) * Math.sin(a2)]; boxY(m, (p0[0] + p1[0]) / 2, y + 0.004, (p0[2] + p1[2]) / 2, 0.012, 0.012, Math.hypot(p1[0] - p0[0], p1[2] - p0[2]) + 0.002, Math.atan2(p1[0] - p0[0], p1[2] - p0[2]) + Math.PI / 2 * 0); } if (i % 3 === 0) boxY(m, R * Math.cos(a), y, R * Math.sin(a), 0.07, 0.006, 0.014, Math.atan2(Math.cos(a), -Math.sin(a)) * 0 + a + Math.PI / 2); } return m; } function train(kind) { const m = new Mesh(); const R = 0.82; const car = (th, len, h, w) => { const x = R * Math.cos(th), z = R * Math.sin(th), y = gy(x, z) + 0.012 + h / 2; boxY(m, x, y, z, len, h, w, Math.atan2(Math.cos(th), Math.sin(th))); return [x, y, z, th]; }; if (kind === 0) { const l = car(0.5, 0.12, 0.055, 0.05); const x = l[0], z = l[2], th = l[3]; cyl(m, x + 0.04 * Math.sin(th) * -1 + 0, z + 0.04 * Math.cos(th), l[1] + 0.025, l[1] + 0.075, 0.012, 0.016, 8); } if (kind === 1) { for (let k = 1; k <= 3; k++) car(0.5 + k * 0.17, 0.11, 0.05, 0.05); } return m; }"

# a little part: its builder call, a colour (or glow) and the snowglobe as parent
def gpart(name, call, r, g, b, met, rgh)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jg} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], metallic={met}, roughness={rgh})
  {name}_p = anim.parent@1(${name}_m, parent="snowglobe")
  output {name} = ${name}_p
end
def gglow(name, call, r, g, b, er, eg, eb)
  {name}_s = poly.script@1(code="${jg} ${call}")
  {name}_m = solid.material@1(${name}_s, color=[{r}, {g}, {b}], roughness=0.3, emissive=[{er}, {eg}, {eb}])
  {name}_p = anim.parent@1(${name}_m, parent="snowglobe")
  output {name} = ${name}_p
end

# ================================================= THE PEDESTAL (the root: it lifts and shakes the whole globe) =================================================
ped_p = profile.polygon@1(points=[[0, 0], [1.7, 0], [1.7, 0.12], [1.5, 0.2], [1.4, 0.3], [1.25, 0.45], [1.2, 0.9], [1.3, 1.0], [1.35, 1.1], [1.15, 1.15], [1.1, 1.3], [0, 1.3]])
ped_r = solid.revolve@1(ped_p, angle=360deg, segments=56)
ped_m = solid.material@1(ped_r, color=[0.34, 0.19, 0.09], roughness=0.5, recipe="wood")
# every 14 s: the globe is lifted 0.35 m, shaken for a second and a half (the tilts die away), and set down again
ped_s = anim.track@1(ped_m, property="rotation", keys="0:0,0,0; 5:0,0,0; 5.15:6,0,-5; 5.45:-5,0,6; 5.75:4,0,-4; 6.05:-3,0,3; 6.35:2,0,-2; 6.7:0,0,0; 14:0,0,0", interpolation="smooth", pivot=[0, 0.65, 0])
ped_l = anim.track@1(ped_s, property="position", keys="0:0,0,0; 4.6:0,0,0; 5.0:0,0.35,0; 6.6:0,0.35,0; 7.2:0,0,0; 14:0,0,0", interpolation="smooth")
output snowglobe = ped_l
# a brass band round the pedestal and the brass plate on it
band_t = solid.torus@1(major=1.23, minor=0.05, segments=48, tube_segments=8)
band_a = xform.move@1(band_t, by=[0, 0.62, 0])
band_m = solid.material@1(band_a, color=[0.9, 0.68, 0.26], metallic=0.9, roughness=0.3)
band_p = anim.parent@1(band_m, parent="snowglobe")
output brass_band = band_p
plate_b = solid.box@1(size=[0.55, 0.16, 0.03])
plate_a = xform.move@1(plate_b, by=[0, 0.62, 1.25])
plate_m = solid.material@1(plate_a, color=[0.92, 0.7, 0.28], metallic=0.9, roughness=0.3)
plate_p = anim.parent@1(plate_m, parent="snowglobe")
output brass_plate = plate_p
# the glass globe
gl_s = solid.sphere@1(radius=1.5, segments=64)
gl_a = xform.move@1(gl_s, by=[0, 2.55, 0])
gl_m = solid.material@1(gl_a, color=[0.88, 0.95, 1.0], metallic=0.0, roughness=0.02, opacity=0.1)
gl_p = anim.parent@1(gl_m, parent="snowglobe")
output globe_glass = gl_p

# ================================================= INSIDE THE GLOBE =================================================
hill_s = poly.script@1(code="${jg} hill()")
hill_m = solid.material@1(hill_s, color=[0.93, 0.95, 1.0], roughness=0.8)
hill_t = solid.texture@1(hill_m, tile=1.2, size="256", program="n = fbm(scale_x=8, scale_y=8, iterations=5); albedo = colorize(n, gradient=[0:#cfd8ea, 0.5:#eef2fa, 1:#ffffff]); roughness = n; height = n")
hill_p = anim.parent@1(hill_t, parent="snowglobe")
output globe_hill = hill_p
gpart("globe_house_walls", "walls()", 0.92, 0.78, 0.55, 0.0, 0.85)
gpart("globe_house_roofs", "roofs()", 0.93, 0.95, 1.0, 0.0, 0.8)
gpart("globe_chapel", "chapel()", 0.8, 0.76, 0.68, 0.0, 0.85)
gpart("globe_spire", "spire()", 0.25, 0.3, 0.42, 0.3, 0.5)
gglow("globe_windows_lit", "windows(true)", 1.0, 0.8, 0.45, 3.4, 2.1, 0.8)
gpart("globe_windows_dark", "windows(false)", 0.06, 0.07, 0.1, 0.1, 0.2)
gpart("globe_pines", "pines()", 0.12, 0.28, 0.16, 0.0, 0.9)
pond_s = poly.script@1(code="${jg} pond()")
pond_m = solid.material@1(pond_s, color=[0.7, 0.85, 0.98], metallic=0.0, roughness=0.06)
pond_p = anim.parent@1(pond_m, parent="snowglobe")
output globe_pond = pond_p
# the skater orbits the pond's centre every 9 s; the train circles the hill every 30 s; each is one rigid part turning about a vertical axis
sk_s = poly.script@1(code="${jg} skater()")
sk_m = solid.material@1(sk_s, color=[0.8, 0.12, 0.12], roughness=0.7)
sk_a = anim.track@1(sk_m, property="rotation", keys="0:0,0,0; 9:0,360,0", interpolation="linear", pivot=[-0.5, 1.47, -0.45])
sk_p = anim.parent@1(sk_a, parent="snowglobe")
output globe_skater = sk_p
gpart("globe_track", "track()", 0.25, 0.18, 0.12, 0.0, 0.8)
tl_s = poly.script@1(code="${jg} train(0)")
tl_m = solid.material@1(tl_s, color=[0.7, 0.1, 0.08], roughness=0.6)
tl_a = anim.track@1(tl_m, property="rotation", keys="0:0,0,0; 30:0,360,0", interpolation="linear", pivot=[0, 1.45, 0])
tl_p = anim.parent@1(tl_a, parent="snowglobe")
output globe_locomotive = tl_p
tc_s = poly.script@1(code="${jg} train(1)")
tc_m = solid.material@1(tc_s, color=[0.2, 0.4, 0.6], roughness=0.6)
tc_a = anim.track@1(tc_m, property="rotation", keys="0:0,0,0; 30:0,360,0", interpolation="linear", pivot=[0, 1.45, 0])
tc_p = anim.parent@1(tc_a, parent="snowglobe")
output globe_carriages = tc_p
# the warm glow of the village inside the globe
glow_in = light.point@1(position=[0, 2.1, 0], color=[1.0, 0.72, 0.4], intensity=18, range=3.5)

# ================================================= THE SNOW =================================================
# a slow drift of flakes through the globe's whole volume (they vanish at the village floor); and a burst that whirls up while the globe is shaken (visible 5 to 7.5 s of every 14), then settles
sn_s = solid.sphere@1(radius=0.004, segments=6)
sn_a = xform.move@1(sn_s, by=[0, 2.7, 0])
sn_e = fx.emitter@1(sn_a, name="snow", rate=170, lifetime=[4, 7], speed=[0.04, 0.14], direction=[0, -1, 0], cone=60, shape="sphere", extent=[0.95, 0, 0], size=[0.03, 0.025], colour=[1, 1, 1], colour_end=[0.85, 0.9, 1.0], alpha=[0.9, 0.5], blend="alpha", max_particles=1800)
sn_f = fx.force@1(sn_e, kind="turbulence", strength=0.35, scale=1.4)
sn_g = fx.force@1(sn_f, kind="gravity", strength=0.12)
sn_k = fx.collide@1(sn_g, reaction="kill", ground=1.45)
sn_m = solid.material@1(sn_k, color=[1, 1, 1], roughness=0.5)
sn_p = anim.parent@1(sn_m, parent="snowglobe")
output globe_snow = sn_p
bu_s = solid.sphere@1(radius=0.004, segments=6)
bu_a = xform.move@1(bu_s, by=[0, 2.1, 0])
bu_e = fx.emitter@1(bu_a, name="whirl", rate=700, lifetime=[1.6, 3.0], speed=[0.3, 0.8], direction=[0, 1, 0], cone=85, shape="sphere", extent=[0.7, 0, 0], size=[0.034, 0.026], colour=[1, 1, 1], colour_end=[0.85, 0.9, 1.0], alpha=[1, 0.4], blend="alpha", max_particles=2500)
bu_f = fx.force@1(bu_e, kind="turbulence", strength=1.6, scale=1.2)
bu_g = fx.force@1(bu_f, kind="drag", strength=1.8)
bu_k = fx.collide@1(bu_g, reaction="kill", ground=1.45)
bu_m = solid.material@1(bu_k, color=[1, 1, 1], roughness=0.5)
bu_v = anim.track@1(bu_m, property="visible", keys="0:0; 5:1; 7.5:0; 14:0", interpolation="step")
bu_p = anim.parent@1(bu_v, parent="snowglobe")
output globe_snow_whirl = bu_p
